subject: english
question:
Choose the right meaning of the idiom 'go the extra mile' in the sentence:

The team went the extra mile to meet the client's needs.
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 2) Made additional effort.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Go the extra mile** is an idiom that means to make an extra effort or to do more than what is expected or required. (अतिरिक्त प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The team went the extra mile to meet the client's needs.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Made additional effort**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Took a long route** (लंबा रास्ता लिया): This means to take a longer path or way to get somewhere, which is not the intended meaning of the idiom in this context.
 
• **Spent more money** (अधिक पैसे खर्च किए): This suggests that additional financial resources were used, which does not capture the essence of making an extra effort.
 
• **Traveled abroad** (विदेश यात्रा की): This means going to another country, which is unrelated to the idiom "go the extra mile."

64:T8f6,
**The correct answer is: Option 2) Died.**
